t: This Act shall not apply to airspace within the area in the District bounded on the north by G Street Northeast and Northwest, on the south by G Street Southeast and Southwest, on the east by Eleventh Street Northeast and Southeast, and on the west by Third Street Southwest and Northwest.

fable.w: The section only carves a geographic area of the District out of the Act's coverage of airspace. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision. There is no real tempting contrary reading, since the text contains no procedural language at all.

qwen_block.w: This section defines a geographic exclusion zone for the applicability of the Act. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, public comment, or advisory process with parties outside the federal government. It is purely a jurisdictional or scope limitation.
qwen_block.s: This Act shall not apply to airspace within the area in the District bounded on the north by G Street Northeast and Northwest, on the south by G Street Southeast and Southwest, on the east by Eleventh Street Northeast and Southeast, and on the west by Third Street Southwest and Northwest.

qwen_chat.w: This section defines the geographic scope of the Act's application by listing specific street boundaries. It does not establish any process for consulting with, coordinating with, or receiving input from outside parties (such as the public, states, or experts) before making a decision.
